answer: Resist Sybils with cross-domain voyage checkpoints: an identity gains standing only by completing verified tasks in three unrelated domains over successive epochs, each checkpoint signed by a different independent verifier. A farmer cannot forge breadth cheaply, because every clone must separately travel the same long route, doing real work in each domain. An identity that stays in one narrow niche, or goes idle, sinks toward its nadir and loses standing, so mass-produced clones decay before they can vote or earn. Checkpoints expire each epoch, so old work cannot be reused.
